messages.content: What is the roster of Manchester United?

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.reasoning:
The user asks "What is the roster of Manchester United?" This likely refers to soccer (football) club Manchester United. They want current squad list. We can provide answer manually or use tool if relevant. There's no tool specifically for football rosters; only one tool about retrieving top scorer from sports teams but not roster.

We should respond with up-to-date information as best we know. But note that my knowledge cut off at 2024-06 and it's now 2026-05. So I might need to say I'm uncertain because data may have changed after training. Provide approximate roster based on known players until 2024. Or ask clarifying question?

Better approach: Ask them what year/season they refer to. Because roster changes each transfer window. Could also mention that I don't have real-time access so can't guarantee accuracy beyond last update. Let's do that. Also maybe give some typical names like Marcus Rashford, Bruno Fernandes etc. But better to clarify timeframe.

Thus I'll reply asking which season they'd like roster for.
